BREAKING: Jensen Huang is considering returning to Nvidia, $NVDA, as CEO as tech executives pressure the company’s board to reinstate him, per FT.

Huang is reportedly discussing a potential return even as an independent investigation by Nvidia's board is underway.

One "ally" of Jensen Huang is reportedly putting together a "war room" of tech executives to lobby for his return.

It's going to be an interesting week to say the least.

🙄I know, I know...😞 All of U are sick & tired of hearing about how the #Uranium #investing thesis is far more bullish today, with U #stocks sitting at unwarranted 52-week lows, than it was in February when they were at 52-week highs.⏫💰🐂🤮  U don't want to hear that the #Nuclear fuel demand tailwinds are blowing far harder now than they were 9 months ago🌀⚛️🏗️👷 or that the Long-term #U3O8 price has kept on rising since January to a new all-time high of $99💲🌋 with Spot rebounding to over $90.📈🛢️☢️🙉

🤷‍♂️Many of U don't seem to care, but facts are facts!👨‍🏫

💲⏫ Nuclear fuel consultants TradeTech reported on 31 October that the Long-term U3O8 price, THE key parameter used by analysts to calculate the economic value of a company's Uranium resources & mine projects, has steadily risen since January by over 11% from $89 to a new all-time industry high of $99!

🗒️ TradeTech also note that Q4 usually sees the strongest volume of the year when it comes to new Long-term contracts being signed by utilities, as well as strong upward price momentum in the Spot market heading into January.  That's why Uranium stocks & ETFs normally enjoy a strong seasonal rally at this time of year.📈🎅

⛽️ Reactor fuel demand has seen a significant increase since January. The World Nuclear Association reports that:

⬆️⚛️⚡️ 7 new reactors have come online (+8GW) bringing the global total to 443 (406GW)

⬆️⚛️🏗️ 8 more reactors have launched construction. (+8GW)  There are now 82 reactors under construction worldwide (90GW), the highest since 1986, 40 years ago!

⬆️⚛️👷 3 more reactors have entered the pipeline of reactors awaiting construction, for a total of 119 (108 GW)

⏫⚛️🌍 18 more reactors have been added to the list of new units being proposed worldwide, now at 336 (299 GW)

👥♨️ At the COP31 Climate Change conference, now underway in Turkey, it was announced that another 17 nations have added their signatures to the COP28 declaration to TRIPLE Nuclear power capacity from today's 406 Gigawatts to at least 1,200 Gigawatts by 2050. That's a +77% increase from 22 to 39 countries, and which now includes 8 of the world's 10 largest economies!

⏫🇺🇸 The United States under the Democrats' Biden administration co-led the COP28 TRIPLE Nuclear pledge, but in May 2025 the Trump administration upped it to a QUADRUPLE of US Nuclear power generation from 100GW to 400GW by 2050.

⛏️ On the Uranium supply side a tale of production woes has been unfolding this year.😢  As per Mike Alkin's chart of missed production targets below, new supply has been seriously constrained by technical mining issues & setbacks, rising production & financing costs, etc., with the small number of new mine construction projects facing similar hurdles in bringing needed supply online in the coming years.🐌  Mining is hard, and uranium mining is the hardest!⚛️⛏️😩

🏦 A consensus of global investment banks is now projecting a structural supply deficit in each of the next 10 years, growing to over 45M lbs in 2035 with no visible path to bringing on enough new supply to meet soaring demand into the 2040s.  ⚖️🚫

📶 Supply vs demand datapoints underscore a Uranium sector that is far more bullish today than it was back in January, with the longer-term outlook pushing the bullish indicators to extreme!⚛️⛏️🔥🌡️🐂🔮👀  The bullish Nuclear news flow since January has increased from a rushing river♒️ to an unprecedented mind-blowing torrent📰⚛️🌊🤯 as a global Nuclear Renaissance has continued to accelerate🏎️🔥 picking up additional tailwinds from the world's largest tech giants committing to secure massive amounts of clean, 24/7 reliable, carbon-free Nuclear energy to power their data center expansion plans.⚛️⚡️🔌🤖💻

And there's the rub...🐈‍⬛ Uranium company executives and Wall Street analysts heavily promoted Uranium as the "picks and shovels" play on AI!🤑  Portfolio Managers, hedge funds and investment bankers loaded up their AI thematic baskets with stocks & ETFs from the tiny illiquid Uranium space.🧺💻🤖⚛️⛏️🛒🐒 

🎈As a result, the deflation of the so-called AI trade for the past many months has led to the dumping of a large volume of Uranium stocks & ETFs into the market, hammering down the U sector.📉💥🔨

🤕To add insult to injury, falling gold & silver prices have led to even more dumping of uranium stocks into the market, as traders & fund managers also hold U stocks & ETFs in the same Metals & Mining baskets as their gold & silver stocks, amplifying the downward pressure on Uranium stocks as they go risk-off and empty their Metals & Mining baskets too!🧺🪙⚛️⛏️⤵️🗑️

Short sellers joined in to try to put the final nail in the Uranium sector coffin.⚰️🔨🩳🤑

🚨🆘🚑 So, here we are today with the tiny Uranium sector beaten down to deeply oversold levels in complete opposition to the sector's far more bullish demand vs supply fundamentals.🔀↕️🤪

Sentiment amongst retail investors has fully decoupled from the extremely bullish U sector fundamentals and hitched itself instead to sinking share prices.🤬 Many of U are falling into depression as U see your U stocks portfolios get thrashed while watching the Nuclear fundamentals get more and more bullish with each passing day!😭  Others of U are rubbing your hands with glee from having your prayers for lower entry prices answered.🙏😇

🌊As has happened for this tiny sector before, we could see the start of a new wave of high volume buying by traders, funds, institutions and retail as they finally come to realize the incredible investing opportunity now being offered.🗜️💥💣  The potential for a rapid recovery rally back to 52-week highs has never been greater!⤴️🌟 Uranium stocks could even decouple from the broader markets and strike out on their own given the extreme asymmetric upside potential now on offer.🎁📈⚛️⛏️💰 Especially if the Long-term U3O8 price hits $100 or higher when reported at the end of November. 💯🌋
